```{r load}
# data from data-raw/short_record_vignette_data.R and data-raw/short_record_vignette_map.R
library(wet)
library(ggplot2)
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

vd <- function(f) system.file("vignette-data", f, package = "wet")
v <- readRDS(vd("short_record_values.rds"))
map <- readRDS(vd("short_record_map.rds"))
prov <- v$provenance
maxan <- "08EE018"

to_title <- function(x) {
  vapply(strsplit(tolower(x), " "), function(w) {
    big <- !w %in% c("at", "the", "near", "of", "above", "below")
    w[big] <- paste0(toupper(substring(w[big], 1, 1)), substring(w[big], 2))
    paste(w, collapse = " ")
  }, "")
}
name_of <- stats::setNames(to_title(v$gauges$station_name), v$gauges$station_number)

# colours come from the gq registry, so no hex literal appears in this vignette;
# assert each class set, because a malformed CSV row adds a layer silently
reg <- gq::gq_reg_custom(system.file("cartography", "wet_station.csv", package = "wet"))
reg_main <- gq::gq_reg_main()
classes <- function(layer, expect) {
  x <- gq::gq_tmap_classes(reg$layers[[layer]])
  stopifnot(identical(names(x$values), expect))
  list(values = x$values, labels = stats::setNames(x$labels, names(x$values)))
}
pal_map <- classes("short_record_map",
                   c("catchment_main", "catchment_buck", "catchment_maxan", "stream_main", "subject", "fill",
                     "lend"))
pal_series <- classes("short_record_series", c("band", "extended", "observed", "period_mean"))
pal_gauge <- classes("snow_gauge", c("08EE003", "08EE013", maxan))

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
            theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank()))
pct <- function(x) paste0(round(abs(x)), "%")
and_text <- function(x) sub(", ([^,]*)$", " and \\1", paste(x, collapse = ", "))

# the windows, as the pilot defined them
windows <- c(migration = "Migration", spawning = "Spawning")
window_dates <- c(migration = "May 1 – August 1", spawning = "August 1 – September 15")
```

```{r numbers}
ext <- v$extended
obs_years <- sort(unique(ext$year[ext$source == "observed"]))
stopifnot(identical(obs_years, 1975:1979))
first_year <- min(ext$year)
last_year <- max(ext$year)
pre <- first_year:1980
post <- 2011:last_year
pre_text <- paste0(min(pre), "–", max(pre))
post_text <- paste0(min(post), "–", max(post))

ch <- v$change
row_of <- function(s, w) {
  r <- ch[ch$statistic == s & ch$window == w, ]
  stopifnot(nrow(r) == 1, r$n_pre == length(pre), r$n_post == length(post))
  r
}
sp <- row_of("mean", "spawning")
sp7 <- row_of("min7", "spawning")
mg <- row_of("mean", "migration")
# the sentences: the spawning window clearly lower, the migration window's range spans no change
stopifnot(sp$pct_hi < 0, sp7$pct_hi < 0, mg$pct_lo < 0, mg$pct_hi > 0)
# "about two thirds" for the lowest seven-day flow
stopifnot(abs(sp7$pct + 100 * 2 / 3) < 3)
# the borrowed departures: the same direction, smaller drops
stopifnot(sp$carried_pct < 0, mg$carried_pct < 0, abs(sp$carried_pct) < abs(sp$pct), abs(mg$carried_pct) < abs(mg$pct))

sc <- v$scores
score_of <- function(s, w) {
  r <- sc[sc$statistic == s & sc$window == w, ]
  stopifnot(nrow(r) == 1)
  r
}
scm <- score_of("mean", "migration")
scs <- score_of("mean", "spawning")
cover <- range(c(scm$extension_cover, scs$extension_cover))
stopifnot(scm$extension_gauges == scs$extension_gauges, scm$carried_gauges == scs$carried_gauges,
          scm$maxan_years == length(obs_years))
```

Maxan Creek runs into Bulkley Lake, at the head of the Bulkley River, which Chinook
salmon use in summer. Its flow was measured for only five summers,
`r min(obs_years)`–`r max(obs_years)`. This article uses the R package
[`wet`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/wet/) to fill in the rest of its record
from gauges nearby, and asks how flow has changed in two Chinook windows: adult
migration (`r window_dates[["migration"]]`) and spawning
(`r window_dates[["spawning"]]`).

**The answer.** In the spawning window, Maxan Creek's flow in a typical year of
`r post_text` was `r pct(sp$pct)` lower than in `r pre_text`, with a 90% range of
`r pct(sp$pct_hi)`–`r pct(sp$pct_lo)` lower, and its lowest seven-day flow fell by
about two thirds. In the migration window the change is small and uncertain:
`r pct(mg$pct)` lower, with a range from `r pct(mg$pct_lo)` lower to
`r pct(mg$pct_hi)` higher.

## Where is Maxan Creek?

```{r map-data}
catch <- map$catchments
catch$part <- c("08EE003" = "catchment_main", "08EE013" = "catchment_buck",
                "08EE018" = "catchment_maxan")[catch$station_number]
catch <- catch[order(match(catch$part, c("catchment_main", "catchment_buck", "catchment_maxan"))), ]
# the caption says Maxan's and Buck Creek's catchments lie inside the Bulkley gauge's
share_inside <- function(id) {
  a <- sf::st_geometry(catch[catch$station_number == id, ])
  as.numeric(sf::st_area(sf::st_intersection(a, sf::st_geometry(catch[catch$part == "catchment_main", ])))) /
    as.numeric(sf::st_area(a))
}
stopifnot(share_inside(maxan) > 0.99, share_inside("08EE013") > 0.99)
maxan_km2 <- catch$area_km2[catch$station_number == maxan]

st <- map$stations
# the two routes, from the values bundle (the map's copy of the gauges must be the same set):
# gauges whose records fill Maxan's years, and gauges that only lend their departures
g <- v$gauges[match(st$station_number, v$gauges$station_number), ]
stopifnot(setequal(st$station_number, v$gauges$station_number))
st$role <- ifelse(g$station_number == maxan, "subject", ifelse(g$extension_donor, "fill", "lend"))
stopifnot(all(g$extension_donor | g$carried_donor | g$station_number == maxan), all(g$carried_donor[st$role == "lend"]))
d_km <- as.numeric(sf::st_distance(st[st$station_number == maxan, ], st)) / 1000
far_of <- function(role) max(d_km[st$role == role])
far_fill <- 10 * round(far_of("fill") / 10)
far_lend <- 10 * round(far_of("lend") / 10)
# "within about": the farthest of each group within 2 km of the figure printed
stopifnot(abs(far_of("fill") - far_fill) < 2, abs(far_of("lend") - far_lend) < 2)

map_w <- 7
map_h <- 6.5
bb <- sf::st_bbox(sf::st_buffer(sf::st_union(c(sf::st_geometry(catch), sf::st_geometry(st))), 6000))
# room below for the legend and scale bar, so neither covers a gauge
bb[["ymin"]] <- bb[["ymin"]] - 0.22 * (bb[["ymax"]] - bb[["ymin"]])
bb <- gq::gq_bbox_aspect(bb, asp = map_w / map_h)
lim_x <- c(bb[["xmin"]], bb[["xmax"]])
lim_y <- c(bb[["ymin"]], bb[["ymax"]])
dx <- diff(lim_x)
dy <- diff(lim_y)

# labels: short names, placed by hand so none covers another or a gauge;
# the Houston gauge sits just west of Buck Creek's mouth
short <- c("08EE018" = "Maxan Creek", "08EE003" = "Bulkley near Houston", "08EE013" = "Buck Creek",
           "08EE004" = "Bulkley at Quick", "08EE008" = "Goathorn Creek", "08EE020" = "Telkwa River",
           "08JA016" = "MacIvor Creek")
stopifnot(setequal(names(short), st$station_number))
nudge <- data.frame(station_number = c("08EE018", "08EE003", "08EE013", "08EE004", "08EE008", "08EE020", "08JA016"),
                    nx = c(0.015, -0.015, 0.015, 0.015, -0.015, 0.015, 0.015),
                    ny = c(0, 0.025, -0.025, 0, 0.02, 0.02, 0),
                    hjust = c(0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0))
xy <- sf::st_coordinates(st)
st_lab <- merge(data.frame(station_number = st$station_number, x = xy[, 1], y = xy[, 2]), nudge)
st_lab$x <- st_lab$x + st_lab$nx * dx
st_lab$y <- st_lab$y + st_lab$ny * dy
st_lab$label <- short[st_lab$station_number]
pl <- sf::st_coordinates(map$places)
pl_lab <- data.frame(x = pl[, 1], y = pl[, 2] - 0.04 * dy, label = map$places$name)

stream_sty <- reg_main$layers$streams_all$classification$classes$WA24111110
lake_sty <- reg_main$layers$lake
town_sty <- reg_main$layers$town

sb_km <- max(gq::gq_scale_breaks(bb))
sb <- data.frame(x = lim_x[2] - 0.05 * dx - sb_km * 1000, y = lim_y[1] + 0.05 * dy)
sb$xend <- sb$x + sb_km * 1000

key <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = map$bc, fill = "white", colour = pal_series$values[["extended"]], linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sfc(bb), fill = NA, colour = pal_map$values[["subject"]], linewidth = 0.6) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = pal_series$values[["extended"]],
                                        linewidth = 0.3))
key_w <- 0.22 * dx
key_h <- key_w * 1.05

cap_map <- sprintf(paste(
  "Maxan Creek's gauge and catchment (%s km²), and the neighbouring gauges it borrows from.",
  "Maxan's and Buck Creek's catchments lie inside the Bulkley gauge's near Houston."
), format(round(maxan_km2), big.mark = ","))
```

Maxan Creek drains `r round(maxan_km2)` km² of plateau east of Houston. The gauges
whose records fill its years are within about `r far_fill` km, and those that lend
only their departures within about `r far_lend` km.

```{r map, fig.width = map_w, fig.height = map_h, fig.cap = cap_map}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = catch, aes(fill = part), colour = pal_series$values[["extended"]], linewidth = 0.25,
          key_glyph = "rect") +
  geom_sf(data = map$lakes, fill = lake_sty$fill$color, colour = lake_sty$stroke$color, linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(data = map$streams[!map$streams$main, ], colour = stream_sty$color, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = map$streams[map$streams$main, ], aes(colour = "stream_main"), linewidth = 0.8,
          key_glyph = "path") +
  geom_label(data = pl_lab, aes(x, y, label = label), colour = town_sty$label$color, fontface = "bold",
             size = 3.4, linewidth = 0, fill = "white", alpha = 0.85, label.padding = unit(1.5, "pt")) +
  geom_sf(data = st, aes(shape = role, fill = role), colour = "black", size = 2.8, stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_label(data = st_lab, aes(x, y, label = label, hjust = hjust), size = 3.1, linewidth = 0,
             fill = "white", alpha = 0.85, label.padding = unit(1.5, "pt")) +

  geom_text(data = sb, aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = y, label = paste(sb_km, "km")), vjust = -0.7, size = 3.2) +
  annotation_custom(ggplotGrob(key), xmin = lim_x[2] - key_w - 0.02 * dx, xmax = lim_x[2] - 0.02 * dx,
                    ymin = lim_y[2] - key_h - 0.02 * dy, ymax = lim_y[2] - 0.02 * dy) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_map$values[c("catchment_main", "catchment_buck", "catchment_maxan",

                    breaks = c("catchment_maxan", "catchment_buck", "catchment_main"),

                     labels = pal_map$labels[c("subject", "fill", "lend")], name = NULL) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(fill = pal_map$values[c("subject", "fill", "lend")])),
         colour = guide_legend(order = 2), fill = guide_legend(order = 3)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = lim_x, ylim = lim_y, expand = FALSE, datum = NA) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.02),
        legend.justification = c(0, 0), legend.box.just = "left", legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        legend.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 6), legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = pal_series$values[["extended"]]))
```

## How has flow changed?

```{r change-data}
ext$panel <- factor(windows[ext$window], windows)
means <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(windows), function(w) {
  e <- ext[ext$window == w, ]
  data.frame(panel = windows[[w]], period = c("pre", "post"),
             x = c(min(pre), min(post)) - 0.5, xend = c(max(pre), max(post)) + 0.5,
             y = c(exp(mean(log(e$value[e$year %in% pre]))), exp(mean(log(e$value[e$year %in% post])))))
}))
means$panel <- factor(means$panel, windows)
# the drawn means are the geometric means the changes compare: their ratio is the change
for (w in names(windows)) {
  m <- means[means$panel == windows[[w]], ]
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(100 * (m$y[2] / m$y[1] - 1), row_of("mean", w)$pct, tolerance = 1e-6)))
}

tab <- data.frame(
  Window = c(windows[["migration"]], windows[["spawning"]], windows[["spawning"]]),
  Flow = c("Window average", "Window average", "Lowest seven days"),
  Change = vapply(list(mg, sp, sp7), function(r) paste0(if (r$pct < 0) "−" else "+", pct(r$pct)), ""),
  Range = vapply(list(mg, sp, sp7), function(r) {
    paste0(if (r$pct_lo < 0) "−" else "+", pct(r$pct_lo), " to ", if (r$pct_hi < 0) "−" else "+", pct(r$pct_hi))
  }, "")
)
names(tab)[3:4] <- c(paste("Typical year,", post_text, "against", pre_text), "90% range")

cap_change <- sprintf(paste(
  "Average flow in each window, %s (log scale). Points are the five measured summers; the line fills",
  "the other years from one nearby gauge each, shaded by its 90%% range. Black lines are each",
  "period's typical flow (the geometric mean), %s and %s: their ratio is the change."
), paste0(first_year, "–", last_year), pre_text, post_text)
```

The black lines are the two periods the changes compare.

```{r change, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = cap_change}
ggplot(ext, aes(year)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = "band")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = value, colour = "extended"), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = ext[ext$source == "observed", ], aes(y = value, colour = "observed"), size = 1.8) +
  geom_segment(data = means, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y, colour = "period_mean"),
               linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = as_labeller(stats::setNames(paste0(windows, " (", window_dates, ")"), windows))) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = function(x) format(x, drop0trailing = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_series$values["band"], labels = pal_series$labels["band"], name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_series$values[c("extended", "observed", "period_mean")],
                      labels = pal_series$labels[c("extended", "observed", "period_mean")], name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Average flow (m³/s)") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(
    linetype = c("solid", "blank", "solid"), shape = c(NA, 16, NA))), fill = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

knitr::kable(tab, align = "llrr")
```

## How can five summers say this?

```{r how-data}
carried_text <- function(r) paste0(pct(r$carried_pct), if (r$carried_pct < 0) " lower" else " higher")
n_pre_c <- range(c(mg$n_pre_carried, sp$n_pre_carried))
stopifnot(n_pre_c[2] < length(pre))   # "reach only"
n_pre_c_text <- if (n_pre_c[1] == n_pre_c[2]) n_pre_c[1] else paste0(n_pre_c[1], "–", n_pre_c[2])
```

Two routes fill the years Maxan Creek was not measured, and each was scored at
gauges with fuller records. A score of 1 is a perfect match, and 0 is no better
than calling every year typical.

- **Filling the record.** Each missing year comes from the gauge nearest in place
  and size with a record that year, through a fit between the logs of its flow and
  Maxan's over the five measured summers. At `r scm$extension_gauges` gauges, each
  record was cut to five years at a time, filled back out and scored on the years
  it had lost: a median of `r sprintf("%.2f", scm$extension_median)` in the
  migration window and `r sprintf("%.2f", scs$extension_median)` in the spawning
  window, with the 90% range holding the measured flow in
  `r cover[1]`–`r cover[2]`% of those years.
- **Borrowing neighbours' departures.** Each year takes the departure from normal
  (its 1981–2010 average) at the five gauges nearest in place and size with at
  least ten years of record then, so needs no record at Maxan. Leaving out each of `r scm$carried_gauges`
  gauges in turn, it scored a median of `r sprintf("%.2f", scm$carried_median)` in
  the migration window and `r sprintf("%.2f", scs$carried_median)` in the spawning
  window, and `r sprintf("%.2f", scm$maxan_carried)` and
  `r sprintf("%.2f", scs$maxan_carried)` on Maxan's own five summers.

The borrowed departures reach only `r n_pre_c_text` of the `r length(pre)` years
before 1981. They give smaller drops, `r carried_text(mg)` in the migration window
and `r carried_text(sp)` in the spawning window, but the same picture: a much
drier spawning window, and little change in migration.

## Does snow explain it?

```{r snow-data}
sw <- v$snow_change
swe_pct <- 100 * (sw$swe_post / sw$swe_pre - 1)
doy_shift <- sw$doy_post - sw$doy_pre
# "about ten days earlier" and "3–4% lower" at every gauge
stopifnot(nrow(sw) == 3, all(doy_shift < -8.5 & doy_shift > -11.5), all(swe_pct < -2.5 & swe_pct > -4.5))
swe_text <- paste0(floor(min(abs(swe_pct))), "–", ceiling(max(abs(swe_pct))), "%")

f <- v$fits[v$fits$series != "carried", ]
fm <- f[f$window == "migration", ]
doy_gain <- 100 * (exp(fm$slope[fm$model == "doy"]) - 1)      # per 10 days later
swe_gain <- 100 * (exp(fm$slope[fm$model == "swe"]) - 1)      # per 100 mm more
# "about a quarter" and "about a third" at each of the three gauges; every slope's interval above zero
stopifnot(length(doy_gain) == 3, length(swe_gain) == 3, all(abs(doy_gain - 25) < 5),
          all(abs(swe_gain - 100 / 3) < 7), all(fm$slope_lo > 0))
spawn_r2 <- max(f$r2[f$window == "spawning"])
stopifnot(spawn_r2 < 0.1)

d <- merge(v$departures[v$departures$series != "carried", ],
           v$snow[c("gauge", "year", "melt_doy")], by = c("gauge", "year"))
d$pct_normal <- 100 * exp(d$dep)
d$panel <- factor(windows[d$window], windows)
d$gauge <- factor(d$gauge, names(pal_gauge$values))
# each drawn line is the bundled one-predictor fit: same slope, refitted on the same years
for (k in seq_len(nrow(f[f$model == "doy", ]))) {
  r <- f[f$model == "doy", ][k, ]
  x <- d[d$gauge == r$gauge & d$window == r$window, ]
  stopifnot(nrow(x) == r$n,
            isTRUE(all.equal(unname(stats::coef(stats::lm(dep ~ I(melt_doy / 10), x))[2]), r$slope)))
}
# breaks inside the drawn range, so no label is cut at the edge
doy_breaks <- as.integer(format(as.Date(c("2001-04-15", "2001-05-01", "2001-05-15", "2001-06-01")), "%j"))
stopifnot(max(doy_breaks) <= max(d$melt_doy), min(doy_breaks) >= min(d$melt_doy) - 1)
cap_snow <- sprintf(paste(
  "Each year's window flow, as a percentage of its 1981–2010 average, against the date half of the",
  "watershed's snow had melted, %s. Maxan Creek's values are its filled record. Lines are straight-line",
  "fits (log scale)."
), paste0(min(d$year), "–", max(d$year)))
```

On all three watersheds, snow melted about ten days earlier in 2011–2025 than in
1950–1980, and peak snow was `r swe_text` lower. Migration-window flow follows the snow: at all three gauges, a year
whose snow melted ten days later carried about a quarter more flow, and one with
100 mm more snow about a third more. Spawning-window flow does not: each of these two
measures of snow explains at most `r round(100 * spawn_r2)`% of how its flow
varies between years, at any gauge.

```{r snow, fig.height = 5.5, fig.cap = cap_snow}
ggplot(d, aes(melt_doy, pct_normal, colour = gauge)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, colour = pal_series$values[["extended"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = as_labeller(stats::setNames(paste0(windows, " (", window_dates, ")"), windows))) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = doy_breaks, labels = function(x) {
    d <- as.Date(x - 1, "2001-01-01")
    paste(format(d, "%b"), as.integer(format(d, "%d")))
  }) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_gauge$values, labels = pal_gauge$labels, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Date half the snow had melted", y = "Window flow (% of 1981–2010 average)")
```

## What it does not show

```{r limits}
quick <- "08EE004"
n_quick <- sum(ext$window == "migration" & ext$year %in% pre & ext$donor %in% quick)
stopifnot(n_quick > length(pre) / 2)   # "most of the years"
small <- sum(ext$window == "spawning" & ext$value < 0.5)
n_spawn <- sum(ext$window == "spawning")
stopifnot(small > n_spawn / 2)
```

- **Each filled year rests on one nearby gauge**, through a fit on five summers.
- **Most of the years before 1981 come from the Bulkley at Quick**, whose
  catchment holds Maxan's, so they carry the Bulkley's own history:
  `r n_quick` of the `r length(pre)` in the migration window.
- **Spawning-window flows are small**, under 0.5 m³/s in `r small` of the
  `r n_spawn` years, so a small change in flow is a large one in percent.
- **The snow is modelled on cells a tenth of a degree across**, about 11 by 7 km
  here, coarse for a `r round(maxan_km2)` km² watershed.
- **The windows come from the literature for the Bulkley**, not from observation
  at Maxan Creek.

## Software and citation

The flows in this article are from HYDAT release `r prov$hydat`; the snow is
ERA5-Land, summarised per year by the R package
[`cd`](https://newgraphenvironment.github.io/cd/) (its layers at commit
`r substr(prov$cd_sha, 1, 7)`); the catchments and streams are the Freshwater
Atlas's, through `fwapg`. The data were bundled at `wet` commit
`r prov$wet_commit`. How the record is filled and scored is set out in
[`wet`'s research notes](https://github.com/NewGraphEnvironment/wet/blob/main/research/station_flow_departure.md).

```{r citation, results = "asis"}
# the citation record each package ships: the first DOI it carries, the version, and the
# commit when the install recorded one
cat(wet:::wet_software_cite(c("wet", "cd", "ggplot2", "gq", "sf")), sep = "\n")
```

Cite `wet` by the DOI above, which resolves to its latest release.

Data: daily flow from the Water Survey of Canada's HYDAT, release `r prov$hydat`;
snow from Muñoz-Sabater, J. and others (2021), ERA5-Land: a state-of-the-art global
reanalysis dataset for land applications, *Earth System Science Data* 13,
4349–4383, [doi:10.5194/essd-13-4349-2021](https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-13-4349-2021);
the Chinook windows from Gottesfeld, A. and Rabnett, K. (2007), *Skeena Fish
Populations and their Habitat*, Skeena Fisheries Commission; the stream network
from the BC Freshwater Atlas through Norris, S. (2026), *fwapg: PostgreSQL tools
for working with British Columbia's Freshwater Atlas*,
<https://github.com/smnorris/fwapg>; place names from BC Geographic Names.

```{r wordcount, include = FALSE}
f <- knitr::current_input()
if (!is.null(f)) {
  x <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
  y <- utils::tail(x, -utils::head(which(x == "---"), 2)[2])   # drop the YAML header
  cite <- which(y == "## Software and citation")
  stopifnot(length(cite) == 1)
  y <- utils::head(y, cite - 1)   # the closing citation section is not body prose
  fence <- cumsum(grepl("^```", y)) %% 2 == 1
  y <- y[!fence & !grepl("^```", y)]
  y <- gsub("`r [^`]*`", "", y)          # inline code is not body prose
  y <- y[!grepl("^\\s*$", y)]
  n <- sum(lengths(strsplit(trimws(y), "\\s+")))
  message("body prose: ", n, " words")
  cap <- 600   # as station-flow
  if (n > cap) stop("body prose is ", n, " words; the cap is ", cap)
}
```
